author: Epic Games
description:
Seen the anime? Play the update — if you’re ready… 

Dive back into Night City with the free Edgerunners 2 Update for Cyberpunk 2077, featuring content inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. https://epic.gm/cyberpunk-2077

Take on a new quest that takes place before the anime’s raw, brutal story begins; carry on Jackie’s legacy with the Dual Wielding playstyle; and discover much more as you pick up the pieces in the City of (Broken) Dreams.
title: Cyberpunk 2077 | Broken Dreams | Edgerunners 2 Update Launch Trailer
